guidebook.intro: Kiswahili kilikua katika miji ya biashara ya pwani. Jifunze kueleza historia kwa Kiingereza: **was**, **were** na **there was**.

tips.title: Historia: was, were, there was
body: Kiingereza hakina ngeli: **was** kwa kitu kimoja, **were** kwa vingi. **Biashara ilikuwa kubwa → Trade was big.** **Majahazi yalifika → The dhows arrived.**
**Kulikuwa na** ni **there was** (kimoja) au **there were** (vingi): **There were many traders.**

tips.title: -enye: with
body: **-enye** ni **with** kwa Kiingereza, na haibadiliki: **a town with history** (mji wenye historia), **people with money** (watu wenye pesa).
**Maarufu** ni **famous**: **Lamu is famous for its old town.** Angalia **for** baada ya famous.

culture.title: Maneno ya Kiswahili kwa Kiingereza
body: Kiingereza kimechukua maneno kutoka Kiswahili pia: **safari**, **jambo**, **hakuna matata**, na **dhow** yenyewe huenda ilitoka lugha za Bahari Hindi.
